name: maybe_Model_SetupFromTypeId
summary: Model refresh for one type id: randomizes equip slots, for type 0x5A rolls a random value into self+0x28C, rebinds up to 32 sub-model slots via vt[+0xE8]/[+0xE4], and for type 0x116 stores a height difference.
evidence: Callees maybe_Model_RandomizeEquipSlots, Model_CopyParamBlock, Battle_IsUnitModelVisible, func_001CA474 on battle RNG; special-cases 0x5A and 0x116; zero callers.

name: maybe_Field_LoadAreaActorData

name: maybe_Field_SetEncounterParams

name: maybe_Model_ApplyAttachPointParam

evidence: Type byte 5 tested in the entry loop, 1..100 roll via 0x001CA474 on rng_4218, store at self[0x3a5]; the consumer of the slot is unknown and there are no callers.

name: maybe_Model_ApplyParamType6

name: maybe_Battle_Ui_FindPartIndexByKind

name: maybe_Field2D_Actor_ReloadMapData
summary: Damaged body: only two leading calls (Game_GetDataManager and 0x0063EDD4) are visible before Ghidra truncates on bad instruction data; the callee set (Font_GlyphSprite_Ctor, Font_GlyphQuad_Ctor, Mem_AllocAligned, std_memcpy) suggests a 2D sprite/glyph setup routine rather than a map reload, but the flow is unrecoverable.
evidence: Body truncated with halt_baddata after the second Game_GetDataManager; callers Field2D_Scene_InitSpawnPoints and Field2D_Sprite_CopyPathWaypoints plus callees Font_GlyphSprite_Ctor/Font_GlyphQuad_Ctor/Mem_AllocAligned/std_memcpy point to 2D sprite construction, not map data reload.

name: maybe_Ui_Part_GetSpriteSubOffset
signature: int maybe_Ui_Part_GetSpriteSubOffset(int self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
summary: Looks up a record via func_0063E998(dm, self->f_1C->f_59E), takes the index at record+0x21, rejects indices >= 0x1E, and returns a pointer into the 10-byte-stride table at self->f_1C->f_54->f_58->f_24 + index*10 (0 when out of range).
evidence: Body returns a pointer into a 10-byte-stride table indexed by record+0x21 with bounds check < 0x1E; callers Ui_TextBuilder_InitLayout and maybe_Ui_Part_SetupFromActorSprite support a UI part sprite sub-entry lookup, but the record getter and table owner are unnamed.
